note: Part: the last equalities, i.e. the value $\kappa^{-3}(\frac{49}{48}\sqrt{\pi/2}-\frac94c_1+\sqrt{\pi/2}c_1^2)$ of the full-range second moment. [L] works with the full-range integral directly, so the first inequality (truncation at $2+c_1/\varkappa$) is not needed.

snippet.text:
theorem integral_sq_sub_mul_etaS (c : ℝ) :
    ∫ σ, (σ - c / κ) ^ 2 * etaS σ =
      (49 / 48 * √(π / 2) - 9 / 4 * c + c ^ 2 * √(π / 2)) / κ ^ 3 := by
  unfold etaS
  have hκ := hκpos
  have e : (fun σ => (σ - c / κ) ^ 2 * etaU (κ * σ)) =
      fun σ => (1 / κ ^ 2) * ((fun u => (u - c) ^ 2 * etaU u) (κ * σ)) := by
    ext σ; simp only; field_simp
  rw [e, integral_const_mul, Measure.integral_comp_mul_left (fun u => (u - c) ^ 2 * etaU u) κ,
    integral_sq_sub_mul_etaU, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hκ), smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
